<script type="text/javascript">

$(document).ready(function(){
	
	$(".btnOrder").click(function(){
		var dataName = $(this).attr("_orderType");
		var order = "desc";
		
		if($(this).hasClass("sort-asc")){
			order = "desc";
		} else if($(this).hasClass("sort-desc")){
			order = "asc";
		}
		$(this).parent().children().removeClass("sort-asc sort-desc");
		$(this).addClass("sort-"+order);
		
		listSort(dataName, order);
	});
});

function listSort(dataName, order){
	
	$targetObj = $("#record-one tbody tr");
	
	$("#record-one tbody").html(
		$targetObj.sort(function(a, b){
			$(a).find("td:eq(0)").html($(a).data(dataName)==999 ? '' : $(a).data(dataName));
			$(b).find("td:eq(0)").html($(b).data(dataName)==999 ? '' : $(b).data(dataName));
			if($(a).data(dataName)!=999){
				if(order=="desc"){
					if($(a).data(dataName)<$(b).data(dataName)) return -1;
					else return 1;
				}
				else {
					if($(a).data(dataName)<$(b).data(dataName)) return 1;
					else return -1;
				}	
			}
		})
	);
}
</script>
<style>
.table-blue tr th, .table-blue tr td {
	border: 0px;
}
.rank {
    /* font-size: 1rem; */
    color: #acaaaa;
}
</style>
<div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="record-one" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="record-one-tab">
	<div class="table-responsive">
		<table class="table table-blue text-center fixed-start fixed-second-60 table-hover">
			<thead>
				<tr>
					<th style="min-width: 60px;">순위</th>
